title: RAW complete amulet readings under one atomic-or-binary lexical packing rule
summary: RAW_UNREVIEWED_NOT_SELECTED. Retain all 71 original and 17 disjoint extension meanings, both whole amulet drafts, their exact constructions and every reader alternative. Add one global ambiguity rule: a written group can denote one existing lexical terminal or exactly two existing terminals whose literal strings concatenate to it. Known saiin versus s+aiin and qokeedy versus qokeed+y motivate a finite complete-parse consequence, not two local spelling exceptions. No target census, implementation, new gloss or successful whole-reader fit is claimed.

original.whole_projected_scope: All84 supplied f83r.9–17 positions, all9 complete clauses, the complete semantic contract, both material branches, attributed claims and alpha closure. Diplomatic limitations remain distinct from this projection.

extension.whole_projected_scope: All33 supplied f108r.45–47 positions and all4 complete extension constructions, including identity, conditional attributed claim, persistent depiction and selected physical part.

fixed_inputs.inventory_receipt: Only lexical metadata was checked in this producer pass: original71 entries exactly equal the extension's frozen71 entries; the17 new exact keys have empty intersection with those71; union size88. No split inventory or target fit was enumerated.
fixed_inputs.reader_scope: Retain the complete original and extension separately for every already-owned ZL3b, IT2a and RF1b alternative. Keep projected working copies, diplomatic alternatives and whole-reader availability separate. The existing reports describe originalIT83 and extensionIT32 groups, but no new reader fit is presumed. Missing whole-reader coverage stays NO_WHOLE_READER; unbound entities, uncertain signs and uncertain seams are preserved. Do not manufacture a reader from another edition, repair a raw group, or select only the two motivating locations.

concrete_content_motivation.whole_content_difference: The atomic use introduces the eagle-part/hawk-part alternative. The composed use continues the earlier declaration of a physical part's provenance. The 1023 primary already records the IT fusion of s aiin as a meaning conflict under its exact atomic contract; this is not a newly discovered observation.

The original fixed whole is a relation to a bird's physical part. The composed reading asserts enclosure of the existing assembly and conjoins the following predicate in the complete commentary. The known extensionIT fusion is already retained as a failure of its old twelve-terminal construction.

one_global_rule.inventory: L is exactly the88-entry union above, with each full tag and denotation unchanged. No meaning or atom is borrowed from powder, Galen, transport, weaving or music.
one_global_rule.analysis_of_a_raw_group: For every exact raw group w, offer [w] when w is a key in L. Also offer every ordered pair [u,v] of nonempty exact keys of L for which literal concatenation u+v equals w. Include every admissible pair, even when w already has an atomic value. Retain duplicate-tag derivations with their different lexical/source ownership. Do not privilege saiin or qokeedy.
one_global_rule.limits: At most2 lexical terminals per written group. No recursive re-splitting of a chosen component, no three-terminal analysis, no zero code, no character replacement/deletion, no alias generation, no crossing or erasing an observed raw space, no new pause/line-start/previous-dy selector. Components may come from the entire frozen88-entry inventory in either whole unit; this shared choice is fixed in advance.
one_global_rule.writer_equivalent: A lexical-terminal stream may pack one terminal or two consecutive terminals into a written group, preserving exact concatenation and order. Packing is an explicit finite ambiguity, not a deterministic prediction of where the manuscript must have a space. It does not identify EVA glyphs as sounds or prove the proposed units to be historical morphemes.
one_global_rule.complete_parse: Feed every resulting terminal-tag stream to the unchanged9 original and4 extension construction schemas for its complete inherited unit; retain their original references, types, scopes and all semantic values. A full analysis must own every raw character and every group, consume every terminal once and produce the full declared content, including both original material alternatives and the extension's attributed-claim rival. Preserve all complete analyses and their distinct meanings; no best-parse choice by desired content.
one_global_rule.what_changes: The old assumption that every written group contributes exactly one lexical terminal is replaced by this single atomic-or-binary frontend. Atomic dictionary entries, their denotations and the construction patterns over terminals stay fixed. A whole written form may now have a lexicalized atomic analysis and a distinct compositional analysis. This is a substantive new representation, not an unchanged-code rerun or retrospective correction of1023/492.
one_global_rule.what_does_not_follow: A prefix need not preserve an operation, and a substring is not automatically a constituent. Only full registered lexical components with exact concatenation become alternatives; surviving complete syntax can constrain them. Even a unique parse under these authored schemas does not establish historical syntax or word meanings.

distinguishable_consequences.positive_construction_to_be_assessed: One global packing rule offers ALSO+OF for the known fused provenance clause and ENCLOSED_STATE+AND for the known fused conditional-claim clause, while retaining atomic ALTERNATIVELY and WING_TIP_OF in their other complete contexts. Whether every whole reader can actually use these alternatives remains unknown and must not be inferred from those two local repairs.
retained_rivals: ATOMIC_ONLY: every raw group must be one existing key. This is the original representation; its known fusion conflicts remain unchanged.
EXACT_OLD_SPACE_ONLY: only the original projected terminal spacing is accepted. This retains the old projection successes without explaining differing reader boundaries.

ALWAYS_DECOMPOSE_WHEN_AVAILABLE: whenever any binary split exists, disallow the atomic analysis. This must face the original complete alternative-branch and wing-part contexts, as well as every other resulting split. It is not permitted to choose the desired sense per locus.

PACKING_PLUS_OPAQUE_SCHEMA: the same complete grammar can distinguish atomic/composed streams without confirming any bird, stone or medical gloss. This is the semantic-evidence ceiling, not a losing control.
distinguishable_consequences.all_case_requirement: Before any later fit, freeze the exhaustive dictionary-derived table of ALL atomic/binary alternatives over every whole admitted reader unit, with unknown groups retained. Check every occurrence, not only a known homograph. No alternative may be removed because it adds a competing complete parse or produces inconvenient content.
decision_outcomes: COMPLETE_FIXED_CONTENT_FIT: a whole reader yields the entire unchanged content under the one rule; report every competing full analysis. Retain only a conditional representation candidate.
COMPLETE_PARSE_AMBIGUITY: multiple complete semantic analyses survive. Preserve them; two attractive locally typed splits do not establish a unique reading.

NO_COMPLETE_PARSE: complete finite parsing under fixed exact inputs fails; close this binary rule together with these fixed constructions. Do not add third components, new aliases, a form-specific exception or a new clause schema.

SOURCE_UNCERTAIN / NO_WHOLE_READER / UNBOUND_FORM: report the actual source or lexical limitation separately. A local fusion explanation is not a complete-reader success. Limits or unfinished enumeration remain unknown, not contradictions.

freedoms_and_costs: All88 word denotations remain unconfirmed;71+17 are inherited, not newly learned here. Broad original meanings and singleton freedoms are not reduced by declaring a packing rule.
All13 construction schemas and the original/extension reference assumptions were authored after exposure and remain substantial fixed degrees of freedom. This is not a general type-inferred parser.

Exactly one new structural freedom is added: one written group can own one or two lexical terminals. At each group all exact alternatives are enumerated; syntax, not a researcher-selected location flag, determines compatibility. Residual ambiguity counts as an outcome.
The cutoff2 is a new limited design choice motivated by both known collisions, not independently estimated. Failure cannot trigger an automatic increase.

The whole original and extension were already exposed and used to invent their readings. The two motivating reader collisions were known before this proposal. There is zero independent meaning-confirmation capacity and no search-wide null or significance claim.
No new behavioral probability, edit-distance threshold, feature bank, target rank or source selection is introduced. No pilot split census or semantic execution was run in this task.
strongest_countercases_and_limits: Other binary splits of the same88-word dictionary can yield competing complete analyses or unexpected atom/composition collisions. None has yet been enumerated; no favorable count is claimed.

Original diplomatic ZL {ck}al, q{cphh}edy and dche[o:?]kedy remain unbound in1023. Exact lexical packing does not remove uncertain characters. Other IT/RF differences and missing whole-reader capacity likewise remain.

The original s aiin and qokeed y sequences are two written groups. The rule cannot fuse across their actual spaces and thereby declare the atomic ALTERNATIVELY or WING_TIP_OF value; it only packs inside a given group. Thus the prediction is sensitive to the preserved reader boundary, not a normalization that erases it.

The extension's direct-stone versus assembly attributed claim is still a coherent content rival. CLAIM stores an attribution, so a direct stone claim is not made a physical type error by the new frontend.

The original source and semantic content can remain wrong even if a packed terminal stream matches. The representation may explain alternate readings of a seam, not a writer's intentional abbreviation or historical homography.

predecessors_and_changed_design.retained: Complete projected assembly is conditionally coherent; nine authored constructions,71guesses and reader limitations remain. This proposal adds no assembly action or efficacy claim.

Old no-new-physical-consequence decision stands. Proposed new question concerns shared surface-to-content representation of two known homographs, not re-executing already entailed identity persistence.
Same-span fused/separate strings are existing evidence about reading boundaries. Historical quality/degree meanings are not inherited or confirmed here; no universal seam deletion follows.
s aiin/saiin reader bridges are old, not newly found. Its different quantity gloss is an incompatible old family and is not mixed with the amulet meanings.

No recurrent one-to-longer substitution rule survived its fixed flank/leaf gates. Here two already defined lexical terminals may be packed inside the same literal raw group; no corpus synonym acquisition or relaxed910search is selected.
Directed reusable parts and whole-form residuals motivate allowing compositional and lexicalized analyses together; they do not certify these88semantic units or this binary packing law.
Closed source-code and entry-context tests retain their original decisions. No full/delta serializer, line-start/PREVDY rule, altered source tree or contextual gloss replacement is revived.

later_selection_gate.requires: Root review of the entire rule and exact available whole-reader inputs before any target analysis. Freeze all dictionaries, semantic contracts, original/new terminal productions, source provenance and complete alternative accounting. No fresh target selection or corpus scan is needed or authorized by this card.
later_selection_gate.smallest_reviewable_work: A finite all-alternatives lexical lattice and complete fixed-grammar parse for the two inherited whole units and all available readers, with an independent parser and explicit source-uncertain outcomes. All original physical/content rivals remain recorded; do not rerun the assembly simulator merely to inflate validation.
later_selection_gate.stop: No automatic extension beyond binary packing, no new meanings, no new source/target, and no local repair of a failed reader. If the whole inputs or unchanged grammar cannot support a meaningful comparison, retain this RAW without implementation.

duplicate_review: Current route and composition context read; bounded searches/duplicates on typed composition, homography and atomic/binary packing; relevant1023/492/629/759/910primaries inspected. Related existing ideas remain separate; no automatic novelty claim from search rank or absence.
access: Proposal and lexical-metadata reads only; no new target paragraph opening, target census, implementation, reserve, image, external source or contact. No route, ledger, review or refresh changes. The known collision strings and whole-content descriptions came from already owned primary reports/drafts; prior exposure is explicit.
